value.label: Device web UI (ip http server / secure-server)
value.detail: The IOS XE web UI was mass-exploited in 2023-24 (tens of thousands of devices implanted); any HTTP(S) server on a network device is standing attack surface.
value.advisories: [{"id":"cisco-sa-iosxe-webui-privesc-j22SaA4z","cve":"CVE-2023-20198","note":"actively exploited in the wild (web-UI privilege escalation, CVSS 10)"}]
value.why: The IOS XE web UI was mass-exploited in 2023-24 (tens of thousands of devices implanted); any HTTP(S) server on a network device is standing attack surface.
value.recommendation: Disable 'ip http server' / 'ip http secure-server', or restrict them to the management network with an ACL; validate the running release with the Cisco Software Checker.

value.detail: 2 event(s) in the collected log window.
